identity: An image crop widget shows a picture, a crop box or drawing area, and controls for framing a target.

scenarios.name: default
scenarios.screen: An image shows three to six shapes, with a crop box already on the image. The box has drag handles; some tasks also show an Apply crop button.
never: An open file picker.
A crop box already outside the image.
A separate panel of object thumbnails.

arrangements.text: The image sits in the center, with the crop controls below it.
A portrait image sits in the center, with the crop controls to its right.
The target sits in the right portion of the image, with other shapes spread across the image.

scenarios.hint: Show the requested colored shape inside a flat image with distractor shapes and a crop rectangle that does not yet frame it tightly. Exactly eight crop handles: four corners, four side midpoints.

scenarios.name: outline
scenarios.screen: An image shows three to six shapes and a dashed target rectangle. A separate crop box is already on the image, with handles for moving its edges; some tasks also show an Apply crop button.
never: A dashed circle as the target outline.
An open outline settings popup.
A crop box already outside the image.

arrangements.text: The image sits in the center, with the crop controls below it.
The dashed rectangle sits in the left portion of the image, while shapes occupy the rest of it.
A portrait image sits to the left of its crop controls.

scenarios.hint: Show a dashed target rectangle and a separate misaligned crop rectangle with exactly eight handles. Ensure resizing and moving can reach the target within the image bounds.

scenarios.name: position
scenarios.screen: An image shows three to six shapes in distinct positions or sizes. A crop box with drag handles is already on the image; some tasks also show an Apply crop button.
never: A separate list of numbered objects.
Position labels pinned to every shape.
An open object chooser.

arrangements.text: The image sits in the center, with the crop controls below it.
The target object sits near the top of the image, with the other objects distributed across it.
A portrait image sits to the left of its crop controls.

scenarios.name: content
scenarios.screen: An image contains two or three text signs and one or two face icons. A crop box with drag handles is already on the image; some tasks also show an Apply crop button.
never: A searchable list of sign text.
A text entry field for the crop target.
An open face picker.

arrangements.text: The image sits in the center, with the crop controls below it.
The target sign or face sits in the left portion of the image, with the other items elsewhere in it.
A portrait image sits to the left of its crop controls.

scenarios.name: aspect
scenarios.screen: An image shows several shapes, an existing crop box, and buttons for the available crop ratios. The selected ratio is shown in the controls; some tasks also show an Apply crop button.
never: An open ratio picker popup.
A custom ratio text field.
A ratio preset outside 1:1, 4:3, 16:9, 3:2, 2:3, and 9:16.

arrangements.text: The image sits in the center, with the ratio buttons and crop controls below it.
The ratio buttons sit beside a portrait image, with the crop controls below the image.
The target shape sits in the bottom portion of the image, while the ratio buttons sit below the image.

scenarios.name: marquee
scenarios.screen: An image shows three to six shapes with no crop selection on it. The image is ready for a drag to draw a selection; some tasks also show an Apply crop button.
never: A crop box or handles already visible on the image.
An open selection tool menu.
A selection already applied.

arrangements.text: The image sits in the center, with the crop controls below it.
The target sits in the right portion of the image, with other shapes elsewhere in it.
A portrait image sits to the left of its crop controls.

scenarios.name: pan
scenarios.screen: A window shows only part of a larger image containing several shapes. A navigator thumbnail shows the whole image and the visible area; there is no crop selection at the start.
never: A crop box or handles already visible in the image window.
The entire large image fitted inside the main image window.
An open navigator popup.
A second full-size copy of the image beside the window.

arrangements.text: The image window sits in the center, with the navigator thumbnail beside it.
A portrait image window sits beside the navigator thumbnail.
The target occupies the right portion of the larger image, while the navigator thumbnail sits beside the image window.
